Name: Shells Collection - Beach Forages and Decorations
Author: ItsBenter
TagLine: Beach forages, new rarecrow collections, coral fence, cooking recipes, craftable, and furnitures to designed to blend well in gameplay.
Description:
**![](https://i.imgur.com/LQeyWhM.png)**
This mod is made to increase the variety of beach forages. It got many little things where the shells can be used for like craftables, barters, and cookings.

*   10 shells / beach forages

*   2 crab pot fishes

*   4 cookings

*   3 craftables

*   17 scarecrows

*   10 furnitures

*   1 special order
More information including the spawn, gift taste, shop listings, and more is available on the mod's "[wiki](https://github.com/itsbenter/ShellsCollection/) ".

![](https://i.imgur.com/CqcVhaz.png)

*   Beach Forages spawn in [East Scarp](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787) , [Stardew Valley Expanded](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753) , and [Cape Stardew](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14635)  maps.

*   Gift taste for some [Stardew Valley Expanded](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753) NPC's
![](https://i.imgur.com/HNm7QJU.png)
1. Is it safe to add Shells Collection mid-save?
It is safe! The additional content added by this mod will work just fine.
2. How do I get this item?The items are designed to be encountered naturally as the game carry on. If you're really curious you can read the "[wiki](https://github.com/itsbenter/ShellsCollection/) ".
3. Is this mod compatible with that mod?
I don't really know. You are free to try, and if you'd like you can report the finding. It will surely be helpful to others.
